findings.description: serve() calls proxy(io,r,*loc,path,q,true,pending) with the close flag hardcoded true on the proxied branch, so every proxied response is written Connection: close and the connection ends without draining a pipelined tail. Two requests in one packet, the first proxied, returns only the first. Precondition: a proxied location and a pipelined packet.
findings.title: A proxied response always closes, so a pipelined static request behind it is eaten

limitations: All RCE is on the upstream host
Static tail is only reachable when the location proxies
